name: Inaya leaver (offboarding)

trigger.description: HR termination or PSA offboarding ticket

variables.INAYA_CREDENTIAL: <idc_... service credential with identity:revoke (store in a Rewst secret)>

steps.description: Disable the Active Directory / Entra account (your side).
The person is already frozen in Inaya. Inaya retries unfinished steps by itself; add a ticket note and re-check later with GET /revocations.
Page a human. Retry with POST /revocations/retry {"email": ...}.
Attach revocation.revocationId to the ticket as evidence and close it.

optionalInbound: Register an Inaya outbound webhook for access.revoked pointing at a Rewst webhook trigger (Identity & Access > Events out); verify X-Inaya-Signature with the secret shown once.
